chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 433 "Saint" (8k)
paragraphs: “Very well, Master.”
Upon Chen Mobai’s summons, Luo Yixuan immediately picked ten saplings from a heap in the distance, and transported them using a magic technique.
Although Luo Yixuan’s farming skills were modest compared to Zhuo Ming, she became adept over the years. The master and disciple had an excellent rapport.
One would hand them over, and the other would plant them. They quickly sowed one-acre of land.
“Shall I step aside for now?”

Xue Ting, who was standing nearby, knew that Green Jade Spirit Rice was a Rank-2 Spirit Rice. Seeing that Chen Mobai and his disciple began sowing, Xue Ting conscientiously suggested to Zhuo Ming that she should excuse herself.

“It’s alright. My master has said, if possible, in the future, he also intends to spread this Green Jade Spirit Rice throughout the Eastern Wilderness. If you can learn the process too, it would also be considered as a help to my master.”
Zhuo Ming said with a smile, accepting the Fire Spirit Rice seedlings from Xue Ting, and planted them precisely and skillfully.
Since she needed to demonstrate the process, she manually planted them one by one. She carefully taught Xue Ting each and every step, such as loosening and firming the soil and watering it.
“I never expected that there are people with such aspirations like Uncle Master Chen in Eastern Wilderness.”

Xue Ting didn’t know how to describe Chen Mobai. At least, this is the first time in her life that she has met such a person, devoid of prejudices, and willing to teach an outsider without reservation.
You must know that before coming here, she had already prepared to face she might be looked down upon and treated with a cold demeanor.

After all, she is going to learn a cultivation technique of Spirit Plants that others had painstakingly developed and tested. If someone came to Snow-blowing Palace to learn about Crystal spirit rice cultivation, it would already be considered polite of Snow-blowing Palace if they didn’t get angry and kick the person out.

That’s why, when Lan Lingping chose who would complete this task, her fellow sisters quickly made excuses to avoid it. As she wasn’t good at socializing and was ostracized due to her beauty, she was the one selected.

Xue Ting couldn’t defy the sect and her master, and on top of that, there was a reward of ten thousand contribution points for completing this task, enough to exchange for a Foundation Establishment Pill.

She does not have too many friends in her sect, and whilst she was close to the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, she couldn’t gather enough contributions, and others were unwilling to lend, increasing her worries.
But hearing that she would get ten thousand contribution points, Xue Ting pushed down the indignation in her heart and undertook the task.

However, Lan Lingping knew how difficult this task was and ensured her beforehand, that as long as she could bring back the complete cultivation method of Fire Spirit Rice without fail, she would definitely get her hands on a pill from the next batch of Foundation Building pills to be produced.
At last, she hinted that to complete the task, she could make certain sacrifices.
It did not need her to clarify what kind of sacrifice, from that sentence alone, Xue Ting understood why her fellow female disciples would push her to take up the task.
For the first time, she felt that being beautiful was a crime.

However, the resentment that emerged from her heart made her mentality start to distort. She started thinking, if it is necessary for her to sacrifice in order to complete the task, then after her Foundation Establishment, she will make sure to let others in the sect also taste the bitterness of her sorrow.
However, the result was completely different from what she imagined. The infamous top Sword Cultivator of the Divine Wood Sect turned out to be a person of extreme sincerity.
The moment she arrived at Xiao Nanshan, her nervousness seemed to be seen through by his clear and bright eyes, and she was immediately placed under the care of sister Zhuo on Court Mountain.

Zhuo Ming was a person of utmost sincerity. Even before the sowing started, she took Xue Ting to the Spirit Fields on the mountains to teach her the techniques and secrets of Fire Spirit Rice cultivation.
And on New Year’s Day, the scene she saw at the top of Xiao Nanshan shocked her to the core.
Could there really exist such a harmonious master-disciple relationship in the Eastern Wilderness?

Xue Ting used to undertake various tasks to earn contribution points for the sect, and she was familiar with many disciples of the Divine Wood Sect, knowing full well that this sect was no different from Snow-Blowing Palace.
Therefore, the intimate master-disciple relationship in Xiao Nanshan can only be said to be unique to this school.
Perhaps for this reason, Xue Ting became genuinely curious about Chen Mobai for the first time. The more she got to know him, the more she admired him.
He was a real genius and an idealist.
If she were to use one word to describe him, Xue Ting thought he might be a “saint”.
“Alright, let’s leave it here for the morning. Come with me to rinse some Spiritual Rice and pick some fruits and vegetables.”
At this time, Zhuo Ming planted the last seedling in this acre of Spiritual Land. She stood up and clapped her hands clean, beckoning Xue Ting to prepare lunch with her.
On the other side, Chen Mobai also stopped. As a master, naturally, he took this opportunity to rest.
Luo Yixuan went over to prepare with Zhuo Ming.
In a short while, cooked spiritual rice, roasted spiritual chicken, and a pot of vegetable soup were brought to Chen Mobai.
Zhuo Ming and Luo Yixuan skillfully sat on either side of Chen Mobai, already eating their served rice. Only Xue Ting stood there, not knowing what to do.
“Junior Niece Xue Ting, sit down, don’t be restrained, just enjoy.”

After listening to Chen Mobai’s invitation, she knelt on the grass with some trepidation. Zhuo Ming handed over a bowl of chopsticks, and she shallowly served herself a bowl of soup which she slowly sipped.
“The green jade spiritual rice may feel a bit hard when you chew, but the spiritual effect is gentle. Have a taste.”

Upon Chen Mobai’s summons, Luo Yixuan immediately picked ten saplings from a heap in the distance, and transported them using a magic technique.
Although Luo Yixuan’s farming skills were modest compared to Zhuo Ming, she became adept over the years.
The master and disciple had an excellent rapport.
One would hand them over, and the other would plant them.
They quickly sowed one-acre of land.
“Shall I step aside for now?”
Xue Ting, who was standing nearby, knew that Green Jade Spirit Rice was a Rank-2 Spirit Rice.
Seeing that Chen Mobai and his disciple began sowing, Xue Ting conscientiously suggested to Zhuo Ming that she should excuse herself.
“It’s alright.
My master has said, if possible, in the future, he also intends to spread this Green Jade Spirit Rice throughout the Eastern Wilderness.
If you can learn the process too, it would also be considered as a help to my master.”
Zhuo Ming said with a smile, accepting the Fire Spirit Rice seedlings from Xue Ting, and planted them precisely and skillfully.
Since she needed to demonstrate the process, she manually planted them one by one.
She carefully taught Xue Ting each and every step, such as loosening and firming the soil and watering it.
“I never expected that there are people with such aspirations like Uncle Master Chen in Eastern Wilderness.”
Xue Ting didn’t know how to describe Chen Mobai.
At least, this is the first time in her life that she has met such a person, devoid of prejudices, and willing to teach an outsider without reservation.

After all, she is going to learn a cultivation technique of Spirit Plants that others had painstakingly developed and tested.
If someone came to Snow-blowing Palace to learn about Crystal spirit rice cultivation, it would already be considered polite of Snow-blowing Palace if they didn’t get angry and kick the person out.
That’s why, when Lan Lingping chose who would complete this task, her fellow sisters quickly made excuses to avoid it.
As she wasn’t good at socializing and was ostracized due to her beauty, she was the one selected.

Xue Ting couldn’t defy the sect and her master, and on top of that, there was a reward of ten thousand contribution points for completing this task, enough to exchange for a Foundation Establishment Pill.

She does not have too many friends in her sect, and whilst she was close to the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, she couldn’t gather enough contributions, and others were unwilling to lend, increasing her worries.
But hearing that she would get ten thousand contribution points, Xue Ting pushed down the indignation in her heart and undertook the task.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 433 "Saint" (8k)
paragraphs: Chen Mobai noticed Xue Ting’s restraint and gestured to Zhuo Ming to stop focusing on her own meal so much and serve her a bowl as well.
His junior disciple obediently did as asked.
“Thank you, but this Rank-2 Spirit Rice is too precious.”

Xue Ting, somewhat awkward, delayed accepting the Green Jade Spirit Rice from Zhuo Ming. She had been on Xiao Nanshan for over a month and had become familiar with Xiao Nanshan’s talent for cultivating spiritual plants.

This Green Jade Spirit Rice, being one of two types of Rank-2 Spirit Rice, is as valuable as the crystal Spirit Rice of their Snow-blowing Palace. It was such a rare delicacy that not even her master, Lan Lingping, could necessarily have it at every meal.
“Eat up. This stuff will soon be all over the place.”
Zhuo Ming said and promptly thrust the bowl into Xue Ting’s hands. She then picked up her own bowl, finishing it clean, and served herself another heaping one.
By this time, Luo Yixuan had only eaten a small portion of her bowl.
“Senior sister has a great appetite.”
Seeing this, Luo Yixuan couldn’t help expressing her admiration.

Having been under Chen Mobai’s tutelage for many years, she understood the benefits of eating Spirit Rice at every meal— it strengthened one’s inner organs, boosted vitality, and during Foundation Establishment, it could greatly conserve energy at the critical transition of marrow cleansing.
However, she was only at the Qi Cultivating Realm, so she could only have Rank-1 Spirit Rice at every meal. Rank-2 Spirit Rice could only be eaten every few days.
Zhuo Ming used to be the same, but since she started practicing the introductory stage of the Nine-foot Law Body technique, things had changed.
Now, she could manage Rank-2 Spirit Rice once a day without worrying about her body being unable to digest it.
Additionally, Zhuo Ming’s demand for Spirit Chickens and Spirit Fish had also increased.

That was a sign of having entered the introductory stage of the Nine-foot Law Body. Initially, Ji Dao Yuan had consumed nutrient-rich Spirit Beast meat for over a decade. After cultivating his Divine Sense, he began using various vigorous blood and energy supplemental medicines to assist him, barely managing to cultivate the first level of the Nine-foot Law Body during the Qi Cultivation.

Zhuo Ming, however, did not set high demands for herself. If not for the desire to not disgrace the Xiao Nanshan line, and the need to make it to the true disciples list in the sect’s tournament in order to obtain a Foundation Building Pill, she probably wouldn’t bother with this Body Cultivation technique.

But her Earth Mother Cultivation had allowed her to comprehend the essence of the earth while farming, making her Earth Attribute Cultivation Techniques much more effective. Therefore, after eating Spirit Rice for two years, she unexpectedly managed to get the hang of this Body Cultivation technique deemed the most difficult in the Eastern Wilderness.
Upon mastering it, Zhuo Ming’s appetite greatly increased.

Luckily, being under Chen Mobai, there was no stinginess with Spirit Stones. Not only did they receive bonuses at the end of each year, but all sorts of Spirit Rice were available, and there was no shortage of Spirit Birds, Spirit Fish, and Spirit Vegetables either.

The Supplements for the first stage of Nine-foot Law Body, though different from regular medicinal pills for cultivation enhancement and virtually free of dan toxicity, were still turned into a medicinal liquor by Chen Mobai at Yan Jinye’s invitation.
This required daily consumption but guaranteed no dan toxicity harm.

So, after the three of them finished eating, Xue Ting watched in astonishment as Zhuo Ming took a gourd from her storage bag, pulled out the stopper to release a rich aroma of wine, then lifted her slender neck and gulped down several mouthfuls.
“Who would’ve thought that Senior Sister Zhuo is such a heavy drinker.”
Among the female cultivators in the Eastern Wilderness, Xue Ting had never heard of anyone who drinks. Zhuo Ming’s easy-going nature made her even more envious.
Only under the guidance of a saint-like master like this could one maintain such purity and innocence, right?
“Rest for a while. If you two have any cultivation related questions, feel free to ask me.”
After the meal, Chen Mobai lazily lay down on the lawn. However, since his disciples had just asked him questions during the New Year’s festivities, both shook their heads when he suggested it.
“What about Niece Xue Ting?”
Being a good mentor, Chen Mobai turned to the diligent Xue Ting, who was still busily cleaning up the leftover food, and asked.
“Erm...I can’t think of any questions at the moment.”
After hesitating, Xue Ting, still rather cautious, dared not to ask.
Chen Mobai heard her and simply ignored it, closing his eyes to contemplate the assembly of the Featureless Puppet.
He stayed on Xiao Nanshan for five days.
The first day he personally planted the Green Jade Spirit Rice seedlings. After confirming there were no issues, he spent the next two days controlling a seed-sowing puppet to do the work.
Zhuo Ming’s fifty-acre Spirit Field for Rank-2 crops was swiftly filled with Green Jade Spirit Rice with ease.
“This is, after all, the first time we’ve planted on such a large scale. There might be unexpected issues, so you guys will have to work hard to guide the farmers in meticulous care.”
Upon finishing the planting, Chen Mobai was ready to retreat for cultivation. Before leaving, naturally, he had to instruct his two disciples.
Noticing Xue Ting also nodding in agreement, he didn’t mind; instructed his students and then gracefully took off in his “Red Misty Cloud Silk”, flying to the top of Xiao Nanshan.
Then, the Cloud Mist Array was activated, enveloping the little wooden house on top of the mountain.
“Who would’ve thought, the notorious Chen Uncle in the outside world is actually a person so simple and unpretentious behind closed doors.”
Watching Chen Mobai leaving, Xue Ting couldn’t help but mutter to herself.
He is touted as the Divine Wood Sect’s top Sword Cultivator, but throughout their time together, she had never felt the keen aura of a top Sword Cultivator from him.
It must be that his Sword Dao had returned to its natural simplicity, rendering him indistinguishable from a simple farming hermit.
“That’s because you’ve never seen our master on the battlefield, he was quite fierce when fighting for Shake Mountain Peak.”
Hearing Xue Ting’s murmur, Luo Yixuan shook her head and responded.
She always believed that the Way of Farming was just one cultivation art chosen by her master to sharpen his sword fighting intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 433 ’Sage (8k)
paragraphs: The essence of a master is a divine sword that will dazzle for all eternity!
Of course, Chen Mobai had no idea that in the eyes of his young disciple, he was quickly becoming more than human.

After confirming with Chu Zuoshu that there would be no large-scale conflicts with Mountain Shaker Peak in the near future, Chen Mobai left his puppet body behind and returned to the other side of the fairy gate.
“I’m sorry for the delay in getting the core chip fabricated.”

After returning to the studio at the Heavenly Machines Factory, Chen Mobai first apologized to Chai Lun. As the chief engineer of the factory, Zhou Tiangong was usually very busy, so the two of them were basically the only ones using the studio.
“That’s fine, the bureaucracy at the Repairing Heaven Institute is very heavy. I would have been surprised if you had not delayed me.”
Chai Lun previously ordered core chips from the Repairing Heaven Institute and had prepaid the whole amount, but each time it took a while for the entire process to be completed.
So he nodded in understanding, handed Chen Mobai the skeletal structure of an arm that he had assembled over the past several days, and asked him to check if it had any problems.
[I feel that the Repairing Heaven Institute is actually quite quick.]
Chen Mobai thought about his two collaborations with the Repairing Heaven Institute. It seemed that as soon as the money was in place, they immediately arranged for the order to be made.
Maybe it was because he had used his connections.
Chen Mobai didn’t talk anymore about this. He meticulously inspected the skeletal structure of the arm that Chai Lun had assembled and found three small problems.
He patiently explained them to Chai Lun, then had him disassemble it and reassemble them.
A month later.

Chen Mobai finally understood why Chai Lun had roared in frustration when he was teaching him. Although he had handed over the blueprints, Chai Lun did not know the Assembly of the Formless Puppet as well as he did. Each time they assembled it, or printed parts, they encountered unexpected problems.
Several times they thought they had succeeded in assembling it, but when they channeled spiritual energy into it, they found that it could not light up.
After checking again, they found that a wire may have been connected wrongly or a part may be sized incorrectly.

Since the assembly of the Formless Puppet needed high precision, an error margin of 0.01 millimeters was unacceptable. However, Chai Lun’s concept was still at 0.1 millimeters, so many parts that had been printed by him had to be discarded and reprinted.
This meant that the work they had done over the past month was largely wasted.
At this moment, Chen Mobai felt an overwhelming urge to curse.
However, he certainly wouldn’t take it out on Chai Lun. After consoling him, they reprinted these irregular parts together.
And Chai Lun, being an excellent puppet master, would not repeat his mistakes. Consequently, as their cooperation matured, the assembly and construction process actually sped up.
Time slipped by as they worked with dedication.
By the time Wenren Xuewei delivered the materials for biogenetics, they had actually completed the skeletal structure of the Formless Puppet.
What was left was to use various materials from bionics to simulate human meridians, blood vessels, visceral flesh, and so forth.

This would require the help of Wenren Xuewei. Although Chen Mobai had a perfect theoretical understanding, he could expect to make multiple errors if he tried to cover the skeletal structure with the materials.

“These small electronic components that simulate neurons are also very crucial. They need to be set in the corresponding positions when you cover them with biogenetic materials. This will make the skeletal structure form a connection with the biogenetic meridians, blood vessels, viscera, flesh, etc, if any one of them is misplaced, we will have to cut it open and redo it.”
To guarantee success, Chen Mobai repeated the relevant knowledge to Wenren Xuewei again and again.
Wenren Xuewei nodded solemnly, confirming that she understood everything and had no doubts.
However, after the actual coverage was completed, they still encountered issues with six neurons not having a connection.
“It’s okay, just consider it a minor surgery.”

Seeing the guilty look on Wenren Xuewei’s face, Chen Mobai comforted her gently, then opened his Void Spirit Eye, picked up a tool similar to a surgical knife, and cut open the biogenetic flesh over the Formless Puppet’s shoulder, precisely finding an electronic component that hadn’t been activated.

Thankfully, the Formless Puppet had no sense of perception. Chen Mobai soon activated all the neurons. After confirmation that there were no issues, the three people in the studio breathed a sigh of relief.
“Next, I need your help, Senior Wenren, to regrow these six pieces of cut biogenetic flesh, then reapply and fuse them with the rest of the material.”
Looking at the Formless Puppet with six small holes cut into it on the workstation, Chen Mobai felt a sense of accomplishment.
Even though he relied on the strength of three companions, he was the leader of this project.
This was the Formless Puppet, the peak of Daoist Academy’s Puppetry Technique.
At that moment, Chen Mobai’s phone rang. Upon seeing the caller ID, he smiled and answered,
“Hello, teacher! Okay, it’ll be delivered the day after tomorrow, I will be there then.”
After hanging up the phone, Chai Lun had already guessed what it was and was also excited: “The chip manufacturing is complete, right?”
“Correct. Fu Borong is going to pay a visit to Professor Che Yucheng, so he will bring it over. I will go there to greet them.”
After Chen Mobai finished speaking, all three of them were overjoyed.
“I didn’t expect that I would be the one slowing us down in the end. I’ll go back to Jumang Daoist Academy right away and try to culture these six pieces of biogenetic flesh as soon as possible.”
Wenren Xuewei said somewhat embarrassingly, then declined Chen Mobai’s offer to see her off. She immediately booked a flight ticket for the same day and left.
“Have you decided what kind of magical treasure embryo you want the principal to order?”
One day, Chen Mobai, wearing the Dancing Device Red and Black Robe, accompanied Che Yucheng to the airport to meet their guest. The latter suddenly asked him.

After Chen Mobai finished speaking, all three of them were overjoyed.
“I didn’t expect that I would be the one slowing us down in the end.
I’ll go back to Jumang Daoist Academy right away and try to culture these six pieces of biogenetic flesh as soon as possible.”
Wenren Xuewei said somewhat embarrassingly, then declined Chen Mobai’s offer to see her off.
She immediately booked a flight ticket for the same day and left.
“Have you decided what kind of magical treasure embryo you want the principal to order?”
One day, Chen Mobai, wearing the Dancing Device Red and Black Robe, accompanied Che Yucheng to the airport to meet their guest.
The latter suddenly asked him.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 434 Pure Yang Qi
paragraphs: Chen Mobai had informed Che Yucheng about the impending completion of the Formless Puppet. This indicated that he was undoubtedly going to be the first one in the graduation project.
Additionally, as the showcase chief of the Dance Tool Dao Academy and being involved in the creation of a magical treasure embryo, he was already all but assured of success.

Nevertheless, Chen Mobai hadn’t thought much about this issue. After all, due to the scarcity of resources and absence of competition among the immortals, many Gold Core Cultivators didn’t even possess a magic artifact.
As a result, research on magic artifacts wasn’t much emphasized among the immortals.
On the other hand, the development of large instruments and appliances for everyday life was flourishing.
Under this environment, Dance Tool Dao Academy could be considered the ancestral home of magic artifacts in the world of immortality.
The Refining Implement Department was reputed to be the best in the world of immortals. Cheng Xuan had been the head of the department before forming his Nascent Soul.
“Teacher, I’m still uncertain. Could you give me some advice?”
Chen Mobai, always eager to learn and humble, asked Che Yucheng immediately.
“The choice of magical artifacts has various schools, but we in Dance Tool Dao Academy classify it into two: ‘Exploit Strengths, Avoid Weaknesses’.”
“Exploiting Strengths involves refining a magic artifact that perfectly matches your own cultivation technique and constitution, thus fully displaying the areas you excel in.”
“Avoiding Weaknesses means using a magic artifact to compensate for the shortcomings of your cultivation technique, so the originally lethal problems become less lethal.”
Che Yucheng explained briefly the understanding of magical artifacts in Dance Tool Dao Academy.

After drinking Enlightenment Tea and consuming a lot of Snow Needle Immortal Buds, Chen Mobai had become a genius. He comprehended these words and suddenly realized that the principle of ‘Exploit Strengths, Avoid Weaknesses’ perfectly summed up the two uses of magical artifacts.
“So, Teacher, do you think I should ‘Exploit Strengths’ or ‘Avoid Weaknesses’?”
Chen Mobai asked again, but Che Yucheng just shook his head this time, letting him make his own choice.
“A magical artifact is a part of your Dao Fruit in the latter half of your cultivation journey. No one else can make this decision for you.”
Che Yucheng’s words left Chen Mobai deep in thought.

Just then, two people dressed in Repairing Heaven’s Colored Cloud Garments walked over. One of them was Chen Mobai’s acquaintance, the former chief instructor of Repairing Heaven Institute, Ling Dao Master.
The other one was a cultured, middle-aged man with grey-black hair and glasses; it was Repairing Heaven Institute’s Gold Core Cultivator, Fu Borong.
“Long time no see, you seem to have aged a bit?”
Standing up, Che Yucheng shook hands with Fu Borong and said a remark that left the latter shaking his head and smiling wryly.

“Ever since the school ranking dropped to the fourth place under my watch, and the dean is also about to come out of seclusion, I have been worrying about how to explain this to him. I have hardly been able to sleep these two years.”
During the offline exchange meeting of Jumang Dao Academy, Chen Mobai’s single sword defeated everyone, pushing Dance Tool Dao Academy, which had always been ranked fourth, to the first place.

In contrast, Wen Renxuewei, because of her successful Lasting Spring Cultivation, could not be surpassed by either Kunpeng or Repairing Heaven, causing the last place to be Repairing Heaven Institute unintentionally.
Fu Borong was still the head of the academic affairs office of Repairing Heaven Institute. Since his tenure, the school had always managed to maintain the second rank.
But suddenly dropping to the last place, the disparity was too great, and it was a little difficult for him to accept.
“Hahaha, I’ve been sleeping really well.”
Upon hearing this, Che Yucheng laughed heartily, not afraid of offending Fu Borong.
“This must be your outstanding disciple.”
Fu Borong chose to ignore him. Turning to Chen Mobai, he reached out his hand.
“Nice to meet you, Teacher Fu. I’m Chen Mobai, a student of Teacher Che.”
Chen Mobai always behaved well in front of Gold Core Cultivators. Seeing Fu Borong’s gesture, he immediately extended both hands to grasp the other’s single hand.
“Youth deserves respect indeed.”
Fu Borong smiled at Chen Mobai and resumed reminiscing and chatting with Che Yucheng after this remark.
“Long time no see, Senior Brother Ling.”

As the two big shots were immersed in their conversation, Chen Mobai noticed Ling Dao Master standing by himself and took the initiative to greet him. He had wholly forgotten that he had beaten him bloody back at Jumang Dao Academy.
“Hello.”

Ling Dao Master responded indifferently. He had chosen public service after graduation and via the arrangement of Repairing Heaven Institute, he was now a civil servant auditing various research resources from the world of immortality.

He had accompanied Fu Borong this time as there was a long-standing project between Dance Tool Dao Academy and Repairing Heaven Institute that needed to be settled. He, as the auditor, needed to witness this. It was necessary to incorporate this transaction into the year-end accounts.
Chen Mobai saw Ling Dao Master’s nonchalant response, so he also didn’t pester him. He simply smiled, standing beside them and watching the two big shots converse.
“In the midst of chatting, I almost forgot about this thing.”
Suddenly, Fu Borong remembered the rank-3 Core Chip. With a gripping gesture in the thin air, a sealed transparent plastic box fell into his palm.
Is this the domain of the Gold Core?

While Chen Mobai was wondering about this, Che Yucheng had already received the core chip custom-made for the Formless Puppet. After he used his Divine Sense to check it thoroughly, he nodded satisfactorily.
“Well, this little fellow gave me some face. This thing is top quality.”
After saying this, Che Yucheng gave the item to Chen Mobai, who immediately thanked Fu Borong.
“Truly, youth is to be feared. When I was at his age, I had just passed the rank-3 qualification.”
Fu Borong expressed amazement at Chen Mobai’s ability to produce a Formless Puppet while still in school, but the latter just humbly smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 434 Pure Yang Qi
paragraphs: “It’s just average, mainly because I taught well.”
At this time, Che Yucheng began to take credit for himself, because he knew Chen Mobai’s recent popularity was too high, and felt the need to share the burden with this disciple.
After all, the higher one is held, the harder one falls.
“You’re certainly bluffing.”
Fu Borong didn’t give Che Yucheng any face because Chen Mobai’s talent was one of the hottest topics in the Immortal Sect in recent years.
After leaving the airport, the four of them quickly arrived at Crimson Mountain.
Although Chen Mobai was no longer the student council president, arranging matters was still no problem. After leading Fu Borong and Ling Daoshi to their accommodation, he was about to leave,
“Little Chen, have you considered studying at our Repairing Heaven Institute for a few years?”
Fu Borong suddenly stopped him and asked a question.
“Teacher Fu, I haven’t planned on further education yet.”
“That’s a shame. With your qualifications, if you were to further your studies at Repairing Heaven Institute, becoming one of the three great hall masters in the future wouldn’t be impossible.”
Fu Borong’s words got Chen Mobai’s heart pounding.
Since its establishment, Repairing Heaven Institute has produced the most number of hall masters in the Immortal Sect.
The current legal hall master was a graduate from the Repairing Heaven Institute.
Moreover, one of the Twin Sages of the Immortal Gate, Ancestor Qian Xing, also laid the foundation for Divinity Transformation by studying at the Repairing Heaven Institute.
Repairing Heaven Institute has always been the most popular Daoist academy in the Immortal Gate.
When Chen Mobai was a child, his dream was to enter the Repairing Heaven Institute and become the Master of the Immortal Gate.
“I appreciate your kindness, Teacher Fu. I will give it some serious thought.”
After thinking for a moment, Chen Mobai’s tone softened a bit, and he did not flatly refuse anymore.

“I have heard that you are cultivating Pure Yang Scroll. The founder Yuan Yang was also a graduate of Repairing Heaven Institute, and we still keep many of his things, including a Pure Yang Qi. Nangong Xuanyu has been asking for it for a long time, but the dean did not agree. If you come, I can mention this matter to the dean.”
Fu Borong’s words made Chen Mobai slightly shake. Pure Yang Qi was a kind of True Qi that could only be refined after the Gold Core Perfection, which contained the true meaning of the Great Dao.
Usually, being able to refine True Qi means that one can start trying Nascent Soul Formation.
For example, Zhou Shengqing of Divine Wood Sect, who had reached the perfection of the Gold Core Cultivation, was already refining Longevity True Qi.
If a cultivator of the Pure Yang Scroll could have Yuan Yang’s Pure Yang Qi as reference, there would undoubtedly be a correct direction for Nascent Soul Formation.
No wonder Nangong Xuanyu requested it from the Repairing Heaven Institute.
“I need to discuss this with Teacher Che.”
Without a doubt, Chen Mobai was tempted, but he also knew that this would not be easy to obtain. In order to avoid being fooled, he had to ask Che Yucheng.
“Right, let’s exchange contact information. If you decide to come to our institute, let me know in advance, and I’ll arrange things for you.”
After adding Fu Borong as a friend, Chen Mobai immediately went to Che Yucheng’s office and told him about the matter.
“He did mention this to me, but I still think that you should make your own life decisions.”
“What I can confirm is that the Repairing Heaven Institute does indeed possess Pure Yang Qi left by Ancestor Yuan Yang.”
“However, this Pure Yang Qi is in the hands of Yuan Xu. Whether it can be given to you is not up to Fu Borong. It requires Yuan Xu’s approval.”
“Think it over.”
After thanking Che Yucheng, Chen Mobai left the building.
With thoughts swirling in his mind, when he brought the core chip to the workshop of the Heavenly Craft Factory, he was somewhat absent-minded.
“What’s the matter?”
Chai Lun, this rough man, also noticed and asked.
Chen Mobai thought about it and decided not to bring his personal matters here. He shook his head, suppressed the emotions in his heart, disassembled the core chip, and began to debug and check it.
Although Che Yucheng had already looked it over, to play it safe, he might as well finish this while Fu Borong was still at the Dance Tool Dao Academy.

Before long, Zhou Tiangong also arrived. His Heavenly Factory worked closely with the Repairing Heaven Institute, often custom-making large-scale machinery core chips, so he had all kinds of experimental chip data equipment.
He was a great help to Chen Mobai.

After confirming that the core chip had no problems, they prepared to install the chip into the No-Phase Mannequin. This was also the most critical step, which required linkage with all the neurons to control the entire puppet.
But they still needed to wait for Wen Ren Xuewei to bring the remaining bionic materials.
Chen Mobai took the opportunity to rest for a few days.
This also happened to be a good chance to think about his Magical Treasure Embryo and whether or not to go to the Repairing Heaven Institute.
“Brother, we haven’t hung out together for a long time.”
At a barbecue stand outside the campus, Chen Mobai and Ming Yuhua each downed a drink. But as they put down their glasses, Ming Yuhua’s mood seemed a bit bitter.

“Ah, I’ve worked so hard to restore a Rank-3 ancient treasure with the juniors of the Artifact Refining Department. I originally thought I could use this graduation project to secure the first place, but I didn’t expect you to be so extraordinary.”
Knowing that Chen Mobai had actually chosen the No-Phase Mannequin and had almost finished it, Ming Yuhua couldn’t help but feel downcast.
“Brother, the headmaster won’t just give the Magical Treasure Embryo to one person. Given your achievements, I guess you’re only second to me. There’s definitely a share for you.”
Chen Mobai said to comfort him. As he spoke, he revealed the real purpose of inviting Ming Yuhua for a drink today.
“Brother, if you were in my shoes, what kind of Magical Treasure Embryo would you ask the headmaster to refine? I’ve been troubled by this issue lately and came to seek your advice.”
Chen Mobai sincerely sought advice from Ming Yuhua.
“Me? Definitely an Artifact Refining Furnace.”
“Don’t you already have a Mysterious Yang Cauldron of Rank-2 high quality?”

“I plan to let the headmaster modify my Mysterious Yang Cauldron as the base and turn this Cauldron into my Magical Treasure Embryo. This will save me the time of refining in the future, and I won’t have to waste time re-sacrificing and getting used to it.”
After hearing Ming Yuhua’s plan, Chen Mobai couldn’t help but give him a thumbs up. Only an Artifact Refiner like him could think of this.
Should I ask Cheng Xuan to modify my Six Yang Divine Flame Mirror into my Magical Treasure Embryo?
It seems plausible. After all, because I had used the Spiritual Artifact Cultivation Method, I had already bound this Rank-3 Artifact to myself, making it my kind-of personal Magical Treasure.
Before successfully practicing “The Union of Differences,” it would be better to directly transform the Six Yang Divine Flame Mirror into my Magical Treasure since I was going to upgrade it anyway.
Chen Mobai shared this idea with Ming Yuhua, but the latter shook his head after hearing it.

“After you’ve used the Spiritual Artifact Cultivation Method, this Six Yang Divine Flame Mirror is essentially your Magical Treasure Embryo. If you let the headmaster make a move again, it would be a waste.”
“Brother, are you saying that I can have two Magical Treasures?”
“Not really, even a Gold Core cultivator can’t afford to maintain two Magical Treasures. I just think you are at a loss in this case; you might as well not take first place.”
Hearing what Ming Yuhua said, Chen Mobai felt it was really so. He had worked hard to gather a team and can’t afford to spin his wheels.
And, others can’t afford to maintain two, but he can.
Although his Good Deed Points were in negative numbers, his storage bag was full of Spirit Stones.
Chen Mobai felt that not to mention two Magical Treasures, even three or four wouldn’t be a problem.
“Old Chen, I remember there are several methods for refining the Pure Yang Treasure in the ancient Pure Yang Scroll. You can try this.”
When they finished drinking and were about to say goodbye, Ming Yuhua suddenly remembered this and slapped his forehead, suggesting it to Chen Mobai.
Now, the Pure Yang Scroll that the cultivators are practicing is revised by Yuan Xu’s old ancestor, and it only contains Cultivation Methods and the Pure Yang Daoist Body.
The original ancient Pure Yang Scroll is, however, quite obscure and difficult to understand.
Luckily, this ancient book is in the Dance Tool Dao Academy.

After hearing this, Chen Mobai immediately went to the library to search for this information. He originally thought that it would be highly valuable, and he would need to ask Che Yucheng for approval before getting it. Unexpectedly, he found it easily in a corner.

chapters.title: Chapter 737: 435: Pure Yang Treasure
paragraphs: Chapter 737: Chapter 435: Pure Yang Treasure_1

Upon opening the ancient Pure Yang Scroll, Chen Mobai found that it was all written in Classical Chinese, and many sections were filled with trade jargon such as Lead Mercury Fetal Incubation. Yet, with his current comprehension, he only understood about ten percent of it.
Moreover, the cultivation techniques, spells, and magical artifacts were all written haphazardly—the layout was not very user-friendly either.
After flipping through the entire ancient Pure Yang Scroll, Chen Mobai finally extracted all the sections pertaining to magical artifacts.
They were namely the Primordial Yang Sword, Primordial Yang Mirror, Primordial Yang Bell, Primordial Yang Cauldron, Primordial Yang Immortal Robes, and Primordial Yang Treasure Beads.
Among them, what intrigued Chen Mobai the most were the Primordial Yang Treasure Beads.

Perfected in cultivation, this magical treasure could transform into a second Nascent Soul. If sufficient Innate Primordial Yang Purple Qi could be absorbed in the future, it could even evolve into a second Primordial Spirit—equivalent to a clone of the Divinity Transformation Stage.

To refine this treasure, one needs a fire attribute Spiritual Pearl which is rather common. However, this method can only take it up to Rank-4 at best, and it will be unable to transform into the second Primordial Spirit.
To reach the peak, one needs a Spiritual Pearl containing the Innate Dao Rhythm. This will then enable it to absorb the Innate Primordial Yang Purple Qi.
As for Chen Mobai, he undoubtedly wanted to accomplish it all in one step. Unfortunately, such materials were unheard of even in the Eastern Wilderness.
Having gleaned the details on the Primordial Yang Treasure Beads, he then skimmed through the introductions of the other five Pure Yang Treasures, his excitement surging dramatically.

In ancient times, cultivators of Pure Yang Scroll held a mirror in the left hand, a sword in the right, wore the Immortal Robes on their body, kept the Treasure Bead in their mouth, the Golden Bell on top of their head, and suspended the Treasure Cauldron by their feet. This ensemble was renowned as the “Primordial Yang Set”.
A cultivator in possession of the Primordial Yang Set was unquestionably invincible within the same realm. Their equipment was vast, comprehensive, and entirely flawless.
Moreover, this set of magical treasures proved beneficial even during Tribulations—it could effectively counteract both the Heavenly Tribulation and the Heart Demon Tribulation.

However, since the era of the Immortal Gates, very few cultivators of the Pure Yang Scroll could afford such luxuries. Though Yuan Yang, the old ancestor, managed to cultivate the six-piece Primordial Yang Set, only his sword was Rank-5.
This was because the sword was his life-bound magical treasure, hence it could naturally ascend alongside the cultivator’s realm.

Upon reading the details of the Primordial Yang Set, Chen Mobai found himself yearning. He had resources from the Tianhe Realm at his disposal. After reaching higher realms in the future, could he perhaps attempt to assemble one set himself?
But that was a matter for the future. At present, his priority was to determine his life-bound magical artifact.
It required thoughtful consideration, which prompted him to brood over taking the ancient Pure Yang Scroll home to study it more carefully.
“This is a copy. You can borrow it.”

Overseeing the management of the Dao Academy Library was a Foundation Establishment teacher nearing retirement. He glanced at the Pure Yang Scroll and nodded, taking Chen Mobai’s student card to process the loan.

“If you are interested in fire attribute magical artifacts, you can find ‘Encyclopedia of Magical Tools Volume 4’ on the C-7 bookshelf on the third floor. This book, edited by the school principal, cataloged such materials.”

A reason was required for borrowing materials. Chen Mobai mentioned his considerations regarding the Magical Treasure Embryo. The librarian, who was from the Refining Implement Department, offered him a suggestion after hearing his intention.
Chen Mobai thanked him and immediately borrowed that book as well.
‘Encyclopedia of Magical Tools’ was published by the Dance Tool Dao Academy and had a total of nine volumes. The fourth volume was entirely dedicated to fire attribute artifacts.

After browsing through it, Chen Mobai found many tantalizing materials, such as Nine Fire Dragon Shield, Five Fire Seven-Feather Fan, Divine Fire Pillar, Fire Jade Heart Lotus, Purple Flame Golden Lamp, Fire Spirit Mysterious Bead, Beacon Fire Straw Mat, and much more.
After reading the fourth volume of ‘Encyclopedia of Magical Tools’, Chen Mobai reviewed the Primordial Yang Set again.
All of a sudden, he was stricken with indecision.

Normally, he was accustomed to seeking the counsel of his teachers or searching online for answers in the face of difficulties. Now, he was left to make the decision by himself, leaving him absolutely bewildered and unsure.
Standing by the window of his cabin, he gazed out at the surrounding green forest and the luxurious villa atop the hill—filled with fond memories, he took in a deep breath.
Chen Mobai then opened the room’s door and ventured deeper into the forested hill. Amongst the refreshingly crisp air, his thoughts began to clear.
He carefully evaluated his strengths and weaknesses and decided it’d be best to compensate for his shortcomings.

After all, upon graduation, he would undoubtedly focus his attention on the Eastern Wilderness. There, every cultivator was skilled in magical duels. If he had any weaknesses, he would be targeted and easily taken advantage of.
On the offensive front, his Sword Dao was already at its peak.
On the defensive side, he had multiple Rank-2 and Rank-3 magical artifacts. Hence, there were hardly any threats within his realm.

Only in terms of his Divine Sense was he inadequately protected. The Big Tree’s sanctity had been significantly depleted when he repelled the Yinming Messenger’s soul possession outside the Sea of Knowledge at the Purple Mansion. He wasn’t sure if he’d be able to resist another attempt.
There was another consideration as well.
After the Foundation Establishment, breaking into a higher realm would invoke the Heart Demon Tribulation. Chen Mobai wasn’t too confident about himself.

Moreover, the successor of The Divine Machine Mansion had prophesied that his Core Formation would face three tribulations. Although Chen Mobai had proactively prepared for it, intercourse with Meng Huang didn’t guarantee he would have sufficient Divine Sense to break through to the Golden Core Stage. Thus, additional security was necessary.
Hence, he wanted to refine a magical treasure that could suppress Heart Demon and guard the Sea of Knowledge at the Purple Mansion in order to solve this problem once and for all.
After the winnowing, the options had come down to the Primordial Yang Bell from the Primordial Yang Set and the Fire Jade Heart Lotus from the Encyclopedia of Magical Tools.

chapters.title: Chapter 738: 435 Pure Yang Treasure
paragraphs: Chapter 738: Chapter 435 Pure Yang Treasure_2
Among them, obtaining the Fire Jade Heart Lotus is relatively easy, requiring only a piece of fire-attribute jade and a red lotus that blooms deep within a volcano.

For the fire-attribute jade, Chen Mobai could figure out a way to trade for a piece of thousand-year warm jade with the Snow-blowing Palace. The volcano red lotus can be found deep within the Treasure Trove, though it requires a considerable number of credits for exchange.
A Rank-3 red lotus needs 200 credits.
However, if Chen Mobai pooled together his credits by the end of the year, he would have enough.
But compared to the Fire Jade Heart Lotus, he was more interested in the Pure Yang Bell, even though the functions of these two magic artifacts were nearly identical.
However, the main material for the Fire Jade Heart Lotus, warm jade, could potentially expose his Turtle Treasure, and the potential for improvement was limited.
In comparison, the Pure Yang Bell offered the possibility of forming a Primordial Yang Set, with far greater potential for future improvement.

However, the materials for the Pure Yang Bell were difficult to gather. Furthermore, because it was to be crafted by a Nascent Soul cultivator, the origins of all the materials had to be clear. The main material for crafting the bell, Rank-3 red copper, was best purchased from the Immortal Sect’s side.
Chen Mobai looked up the prices online and found that if he wanted to create the Pure Yang Bell, he would likely need to spend nearly twenty million Good Deed Points purchasing red copper.
Furthermore, Rank-3 red copper was regulated by the Immortal Sect, and as a cultivator at the Foundation Establishment stage, he couldn’t buy it yet.
However, if he decided to choose the Pure Yang Bell as the embryo for his magical treasure, perhaps Master Cheng Xuan and Teacher Che Yucheng would help him out?

If all else fails, he could choose Ming Yuhua’s method and fabricate a bell-shaped artifact from the “Device Nurturing Sphere”, then have the headmaster modify it. That way, he could save a lot on material costs.
With these thoughts, Chen Mobai tentatively set the Pure Yang Bell as his first choice for his magical treasure embryo.
After making the decision, he was suddenly free from his worries.
After thanking Ming Yuhua over a phone call, Chen Mobai once again energetically dived into adjustments to the Faceless Puppet.
Indeed, the peak of the Immortal Sect’s Puppetry Technique was extraordinary, as they encountered a variety of problems during the debugging process.

However, Chen Mobai overcame these challenges one by one while in a state of total comprehension. The replacing of components and other related tasks cost another one to two million Good Deed Points, but these costs were all counted on Zhou Tiangong’s account.
During this time, Wenren Xuewei was also regularly on a video call with them because the materials for Bionics could only be cultivated and created at the Jumang Daoist Academy.
The items needed for recultivation were all ordered by Chen Mobai and then promptly arranged by her. The materials were then shipped at the fastest speed possible.
They had initially predicted that they would complete it by the end of June, but ultimately, it was dragged out until the end of August.
However, no one complained because they saw the Faceless Puppet become more and more perfect each day.

By the time it was finally complete, the expressionless puppet, standing in the middle of the workshop looking similar to a human figure, drew contented smiles from Chen Mobai, his two companions, and even Wenren Xuewei, who was on the video call.
“Let’s try to activate it.”

Zhou Tiangong took out a spirit stone that had been charged by the Immortal Sect, expertly placed it in the puppet’s head, then inputted a Qi Cultivation technique and began the process of Foundation Establishment.
In the cluttered workshop filled with various parts and tools, the Faceless Puppet gradually became transparent. Its meridians, bones, and internal organs slowly emerged.
Under the tense gazes of the four individuals, the number wheel situated in the puppet’s left eye began to slowly rotate, moving from “zero” to “one”.
It then quickly became “nine”, signifying the beginning of the simulated Foundation Establishment process.
Seeing this scene in front of them, the foursome couldn’t help but feel overjoyed, exchanging high fives.
More than half a year’s effort had finally yielded perfect results today.
“The three of you have worked hard.”
Although Wenren Xuewei wasn’t physically there, she empathized with them and gave them a gentle round of applause, smiling warmly at the three through the video call.
“You’ve also worked hard, senior sister.”
Although Wenren Xuewei had only been there three or four times, without her help at Jumang Daoist Academy, the progress of the Faceless Puppet might have been delayed by a year or two.

“Senior sister, you should come and celebrate with us. The day after tomorrow, we’re going to the Immortal Sect’s Certification Department to apply for certification for the Faceless Puppet. As long as we pass, the four of us can get our Rank-3 Puppet Master certificates.”
Chen Mobai invited Wenren Xuewei, who was on the video call. She nodded her agreement. It was such an important occasion; she needed to be there in person.
Afterwards, Chen Mobai filmed a video of the operational Faceless Puppet and sent it to Che Yucheng, attaching a short message.
[Teacher, I’ve done it.]
In his office, Che Yucheng, who was reading a newspaper, glanced at the video on his mobile screen and involuntarily held his breath. A sense of indescribable satisfaction appeared on his aged face.
[Good job, you can graduate now.]
Seeing this message, Chen Mobai couldn’t help but smile, though he remained humble.
[I still have a lot to learn.]
Laughing heartily, Che Yucheng watched the video of the Faceless Puppet operating over and over, and eventually couldn’t resist visiting Chen Mobai’s workshop in person.
“Master Che!”
All three present were students of Che Yucheng, their faces full of reverence when they saw him.
“You’ve all done excellent.”
Touching the Faceless Puppet, which although still lacking some refinement was already functionally complete, a look of delight filled Che Yucheng’s face.

“The professional certification for Rank-3 Puppet Masters has to go through me, as I am the authority on the Faceless Puppet. There’s nothing wrong with yours; you will definitely get the Rank-3 certificates.”

chapters.title: Chapter 739: 435: Pure Yang Treasure
paragraphs: Chapter 739: Chapter 435: Pure Yang Treasure _3
After checking everything personally, Che Yucheng said something that delighted Chen Mobai and his group even more.
When Wen Renxuewei arrived and the four of them took the Faceless Puppet to the Immortal Door for verification, it immediately alarmed Hong Mengkui, the lord of Crimson City Cave Heaven.
The Rank-3 certification for a Puppet Master is different from other Rank-3 professions, the only standard is the Faceless Puppet.
The Faceless Puppet is something that only the four Daoist Academies possess. Even the top ten colleges can’t produce it.
With this certificate, the four of them, if willing to refine the Faceless Puppet, could be offered an astronomical price by the top ten colleges to invite them over.

However, among these four, three graduated from the Dance Tool Dao Academy, and one is a disciple of Long-lasting Dao Spring Cultivation from Jumang Daoist Academy; they would definitely not go to the top ten colleges.
“Please wait a moment, I’ll call Che Yucheng for verification.”
Sure enough, after Hong Mengkui attempted some of the functions of the Faceless Puppet himself, he made them sit and called Che Yucheng personally.
On the other end of the call, Che Yucheng acted in disbelief, shocked that there were juniors in the Immortal Gate who could refine the Faceless Puppet.
“Oh, so it was my disciples who accomplished this. No wonder then.”
When Che Yucheng arrived and saw Chen Mobai, he acted as though he had just understood something.
Hong Mengkui, who was on the side, felt a bit uncomfortable after listening to him.

On the contrary, the leaders of the professional certification department of the Immortal Gate immediately followed Che Yucheng’s words and praised them. They all admired that the Dance Tool Dao Academy was indeed the number one university in the Immortal Gate, and Chen Mobai was truly deserving of the Qualification of Deification...

After a long bout of praise, under the gaze of everyone, Che Yucheng demonstrated all expected functions of the Faceless Puppet, including performance, calculation, cultivation, magic duel, and protection, etc.
After ensuring there were no issues in any aspect, Che Yucheng ticked all the boxes on a form, signed his own name, and stamped it with his professional seal.
Chen Mobai looked at it and realized it was the seal of a Rank-4 Puppet Master.

“Among the Immortals, there are only two Rank-4 Puppet Masters, Che Yucheng and Master Xin Ji from Jumang Daoist Academy. To reward them for their groundbreaking achievement of the Faceless Puppet, after Master Xin Ji passed away, only Che Yucheng remains.”
Seeing Chen Mobai looking puzzled, Wen Renxuewei explained.
After hearing this, Chen Mobai seemed to understand. He had heard of this before.
“What kind of person was Master Xin Ji?”

After seeing Che Yucheng complete the verification of the Faceless Puppet and start chatting with Hong Mengkui, and the staff of the Immortal Gate Professional Certification Department had gone to produce the Rank-3 Puppet Master certificates and stamps for the four of them, Chen Mobai started a conversation with Wen Renxuewei.
“He was a versatile scholar. Among the students of the Four Daoist Academies of his time, no one was his match, almost like you are now.”
Chen Mobai became curious at this.
He was currently considered as one with the Qualification of Deification.
“Master Yuan Xu of the Repairing Heaven Institute was in the same class as Master Xin Ji, but was known as ‘the eternal second’ because he couldn’t outperform Master Xin Ji.”
Chen Mobai was shocked when he heard this.
Who was Master Yuan Xu? He was the only recipient of the “Flying Immortal Award” in the last thousand years among the Immortals, known as having half of the existence the Transformation God Level.
The fact that Master Xin Ji could suppress him... That meant he could be compared with Chen Mobai who had the Qualification of Deification.
“The loss of such a hero is indeed a great loss for the Immortal Gate.”
Chen Mobai lamented. Logically speaking, since Master Xin Ji had been more outstanding than Master Yuan Xu in his youth, he should have reached the stage of “Nascent Soul Formation”.
However, he only reached the Golden Core Realm and passed away thirty years ago.
This proved that being intelligent at a young age doesn’t necessarily mean the same in adulthood.

Chen Mobai realized he couldn’t become complacent due to his current achievements at school. He needed to stay humble, work hard, and strive to improve himself, aiming to become like Master Yuan Xu, not Master Xin Ji.

“In fact, Master Xin Ji initially had hope for the “Nascent Soul Formation”, but due to the successive death of his adept partner and daughter, his Dao heart became desolate, and ultimately, the “Nascent Soul Formation” failed. Afterwards, he got somewhat obsessed...”
When she spoke to this point, Wen Renxuewei suddenly hesitated and didn’t continue.
Chen Mobai glanced at her, he hates it when people leave sentences unfinished.
“Did Master Xin Ji die of obsession?”

“I’m not sure. A lot of his dossiers in the Immortal Gates were actually altered and deleted. Because I practice the Long-lasting Spring Cultivation, I have higher privileges in the Daoist Academies, so I know a bit about his life after his failed attempt at “Nascent Soul Formation”. He spent the rest of his life trying to resurrect his adept partner and daughter, and the Faceless Puppet was one of his attempts.”

Perhaps Chen Mobai’s talent exhibited over the past few days had won Wen Renxuewei over, she hesitated for a while, then suddenly used a secret transmission technique to relay these words to Chen Mobai’s ears.
After hearing this, Chen Mobai was shocked: “Resurrecting partner and daughter with puppets? How could such an earth-shattering thing be possible?”

“Others may not be able to make it, but I believe it is possible for Master Xin Ji. He was a Rank-4 professional in alchemy, medicine, puppetry, bionics, human cell engineering, spiritology, etc. He could potentially find a way.”
Wen Renxuewei shook her head. Originally, she didn’t believe in these things either. But until nine years ago at the new-student induction ceremony at the Daoist Academy, she saw that person.
“But Master Xin Ji passed away in the end right? He must not have accomplished the resurrection, right?”
Chen Mobai said again, believing that resurrection was impossible.
“There’s something I don’t know if I should tell you.”
Wen Renxuewei’s remark made Chen Mobai raise his eyebrows. He despised those who beat around the bush.
However, recalling that the last person who did this in front of him was the heir of The Divine Machine Mansion, he immediately began to ask for advice humbly.
Chen Mobai: “Feel free to speak.”
Wen Renxuewei: “Qing Nu is your friend, right?”
Chen Mobai: “Yes, the best kind.”
Wen Renxuewei: “She looks exactly like Master Xin Ji’s daughter.”
After hearing this, Chen Mobai was instantly shocked on the spot, unable to utter a word.

With this certificate, the four of them, if willing to refine the Faceless Puppet, could be offered an astronomical price by the top ten colleges to invite them over.

However, among these four, three graduated from the Dance Tool Dao Academy, and one is a disciple of Long-lasting Dao Spring Cultivation from Jumang Daoist Academy; they would definitely not go to the top ten colleges.
“Please wait a moment, I’ll call Che Yucheng for verification.”
Sure enough, after Hong Mengkui attempted some of the functions of the Faceless Puppet himself, he made them sit and called Che Yucheng personally.
On the other end of the call, Che Yucheng acted in disbelief, shocked that there were juniors in the Immortal Gate who could refine the Faceless Puppet.
“Oh, so it was my disciples who accomplished this.
No wonder then.”
When Che Yucheng arrived and saw Chen Mobai, he acted as though he had just understood something.
Hong Mengkui, who was on the side, felt a bit uncomfortable after listening to him.
On the contrary, the leaders of the professional certification department of the Immortal Gate immediately followed Che Yucheng’s words and praised them.
They all admired that the Dance Tool Dao Academy was indeed the number one university in the Immortal Gate, and Chen Mobai was truly deserving of the Qualification of Deification...

After a long bout of praise, under the gaze of everyone, Che Yucheng demonstrated all expected functions of the Faceless Puppet, including performance, calculation, cultivation, magic duel, and protection, etc.
After ensuring there were no issues in any aspect, Che Yucheng ticked all the boxes on a form, signed his own name, and stamped it with his professional seal.
Chen Mobai looked at it and realized it was the seal of a Rank-4 Puppet Master.
“Among the Immortals, there are only two Rank-4 Puppet Masters, Che Yucheng and Master Xin Ji from Jumang Daoist Academy.
To reward them for their groundbreaking achievement of the Faceless Puppet, after Master Xin Ji passed away, only Che Yucheng remains.”
Seeing Chen Mobai looking puzzled, Wen Renxuewei explained.
After hearing this, Chen Mobai seemed to understand.
He had heard of this before.
“What kind of person was Master Xin Ji?”

After seeing Che Yucheng complete the verification of the Faceless Puppet and start chatting with Hong Mengkui, and the staff of the Immortal Gate Professional Certification Department had gone to produce the Rank-3 Puppet Master certificates and stamps for the four of them, Chen Mobai started a conversation with Wen Renxuewei.
“He was a versatile scholar.
Among the students of the Four Daoist Academies of his time, no one was his match, almost like you are now.”
Chen Mobai became curious at this.
He was currently considered as one with the Qualification of Deification.
“Master Yuan Xu of the Repairing Heaven Institute was in the same class as Master Xin Ji, but was known as ‘the eternal second’ because he couldn’t outperform Master Xin Ji.”
Chen Mobai was shocked when he heard this.
Who was Master Yuan Xu?
He was the only recipient of the “Flying Immortal Award” in the last thousand years among the Immortals, known as having half of the existence the Transformation God Level.
The fact that Master Xin Ji could suppress him...
That meant he could be compared with Chen Mobai who had the Qualification of Deification.
“The loss of such a hero is indeed a great loss for the Immortal Gate.”
Chen Mobai lamented.
Logically speaking, since Master Xin Ji had been more outstanding than Master Yuan Xu in his youth, he should have reached the stage of “Nascent Soul Formation”.
However, he only reached the Golden Core Realm and passed away thirty years ago.
This proved that being intelligent at a young age doesn’t necessarily mean the same in adulthood.
Chen Mobai realized he couldn’t become complacent due to his current achievements at school.
He needed to stay humble, work hard, and strive to improve himself, aiming to become like Master Yuan Xu, not Master Xin Ji.

“In fact, Master Xin Ji initially had hope for the “Nascent Soul Formation”, but due to the successive death of his adept partner and daughter, his Dao heart became desolate, and ultimately, the “Nascent Soul Formation” failed.
Afterwards, he got somewhat obsessed...”
When she spoke to this point, Wen Renxuewei suddenly hesitated and didn’t continue.
Chen Mobai glanced at her, he hates it when people leave sentences unfinished.
“Did Master Xin Ji die of obsession?”
“I’m not sure.
A lot of his dossiers in the Immortal Gates were actually altered and deleted.
Because I practice the Long-lasting Spring Cultivation, I have higher privileges in the Daoist Academies, so I know a bit about his life after his failed attempt at “Nascent Soul Formation”.
He spent the rest of his life trying to resurrect his adept partner and daughter, and the Faceless Puppet was one of his attempts.”

Perhaps Chen Mobai’s talent exhibited over the past few days had won Wen Renxuewei over, she hesitated for a while, then suddenly used a secret transmission technique to relay these words to Chen Mobai’s ears.
After hearing this, Chen Mobai was shocked: “Resurrecting partner and daughter with puppets?
How could such an earth-shattering thing be possible?”
“Others may not be able to make it, but I believe it is possible for Master Xin Ji.
He was a Rank-4 professional in alchemy, medicine, puppetry, bionics, human cell engineering, spiritology, etc.
He could potentially find a way.”
Wen Renxuewei shook her head.
Originally, she didn’t believe in these things either.
But until nine years ago at the new-student induction ceremony at the Daoist Academy, she saw that person.
“But Master Xin Ji passed away in the end right?
He must not have accomplished the resurrection, right?”
Chen Mobai said again, believing that resurrection was impossible.
“There’s something I don’t know if I should tell you.”
Wen Renxuewei’s remark made Chen Mobai raise his eyebrows.
He despised those who beat around the bush.
However, recalling that the last person who did this in front of him was the heir of The Divine Machine Mansion, he immediately began to ask for advice humbly.
Chen Mobai: “Feel free to speak.”
Wen Renxuewei: “Qing Nu is your friend, right?”
Chen Mobai: “Yes, the best kind.”
Wen Renxuewei: “She looks exactly like Master Xin Ji’s daughter.”
After hearing this, Chen Mobai was instantly shocked on the spot, unable to utter a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 740: 436: The War Begins
paragraphs: Chapter 740: Chapter 436: The War Begins_1
Chen Mobai had once suspected Qing Nu’s background.
However, after hearing what Kong Feichen was saying about their childhood, Chen Mobai felt that the undercurrents ran deep, and it’s better for him not to know.

But after hearing what Wen Renxuewei said today, coupled with what he already knew, Chen Mobai felt like he was lost in a fog, sensing that there might be a significant secret of the Celestial World hidden within.

He recalled the time when he was at Jumang Daoist Academy, where Kong Feichen handed over the Devouring Heaven Serpent to him, and mentioned that it involved the three Hall Master of the Celestial World.
If it was indeed true, even Nascent Soul realm lords might not be able to cover it.
Chen Mobai started to worry about Qing Nu. As one of his best friends, he had a good understanding of her personality.

She is in the Repair Heaven group, and he didn’t know if she would heed advice. If she were still investigating their childhood, the closer she got to the truth, the deeper she might sink into the abyss.
“Does anyone else know about this other than you?”
Chen Mobai asked with a stern face. Wen Renxuewei hesitated for a moment before nodding slightly.
“The principal knows about it, but she asked me not to mind it and just treat it as a common student affair.”
The principal of Jumang Daoist Academy is Tao Hua.
However, as a Heavenly Spiritual Root, before Qing Nu was exempted from the academy entrance examination, all her details must have been scrutinized by Jumang Daoist Academy.

The matter of their childhood, with the power and influence of Jumang Daoist Academy, they would definitely know part of the truth. Since Tao Hua takes such an attitude, at least the Celestial World has a friendly attitude towards Qing Nu, who is a Heavenly Spiritual Root.
Listening to Wen Renxuewei’s words, Chen Mobai felt a little relieved.
However, in his heart, he had remembered this matter. In the future, if he could hold a high position in the Celestial World, he would definitely revisit this matter.
“Thank you, senior sister, for reminding me.”
Chen Mobai thanked Wen Renxuewei politely, who smiled gently in return.
At this time, the Certification Department of the Celestial World had already prepared their Rank-3 Puppet Master certificates and seals.
“Let’s go, it’s rare for you to come here. I’m hosting today. You four should come along as well.”
On the other side, Hong Mengkui had already invited Che Yucheng to catch up on old times, and he waved at Chen Mobai and the others.
The six of them arrived at a tastefully decorated restaurant in Crimson City. The two big shots sat down to chat over tea, even mentioning Bian Jingchun.
“I have yet to thank you for letting her use the True Dragon Ding for her cultivation.”

“It’s a small matter. No matter how top-ranked the Magic Artifact is, it can only play a role when used. Besides being your disciple, she is also a graduate of our academy. If I can help set the foundation of her Core Formation and Dragon Transformation, it would be a merit of my tenure.”
Che Yucheng said, downplaying the matter. As the dean of the Dance Tool Dao Academy, although he was distracted by various chores on ordinary days, he always prioritized education.
Chen Mobai had been in the academy for nearly a decade and had never seen Che Yucheng missing a single puppetry class.
Speaking of Bian Jingchun, Chen Mobai had almost completely forgotten his senior sister.

It seems that she still uses the True Dragon Ding for her Dragon Transformation Scripture Technique cultivation in Treasure Trove. I wonder how many Spirit Stones she has to give up to use the Rank-4 Magic Artifact?

The profits of the True Dragon Ding should be less than that of the Purple Electric Sword. If he wants to cultivate the Dragon Transformation Scripture Technique in the future, he certainly cannot offer such high compensation again.

Now, Chen Mobai regretted giving a top-grade Spirit Stone to the Purple Electric Sword every year. If he had known this earlier, he would have consulted Pei Qingshuang about the market situation and potentially saved more than half.
After completing the formless puppet, Chen Mobai had finished his graduation project from the Dance Tool Dao Academy in advance.
After celebrating for two days with his three partners Zhou Tiangong, Chai Lun, and Wen Renxuewei, they all went their separate ways.

After all, each of them is a True Cultivator. Even the worst among them, Chai Lun, is the owner of a company. He hasn’t taken any orders because of the formless puppet project, and he now urgently needs to go back and save his puppet-making company from bankruptcy.
Zhou Tiangong, as the chief engineer of the Heavenly Work Factory, is the busiest of the four. He could only stay half a day at the celebration.
Finally, it was Chen Mobai who saw off Wen Renxuewei and Chai Lun.
“I’m probably going to reach Core Formation soon. You have to hurry up too. Don’t make us wait too long.”
Before leaving, Wen Renxuewei teased Chen Mobai, which made him slightly stunned.
“Lasting Spring Cultivation is really incredible.”
Listening on the side, Chai Lun, was full of admiration. In the entire Celestial World, it is only Wen Renxuewei who doesn’t need to wait for the Gold Core Spiritual Material.
“I may still need twenty years. After all, I still need to cultivate my Pure Yang Daoist Body to the six Yang realm.”
Chen Mobai thought about his plan of Core Formation, his heart moved slightly, and he took this opportunity to reveal a bit of his plans for the future in front of his two good friends.
“Oh, could it be that you have inherited work experience from your predecessor?”
Chai Lun looked surprised. Apart from that, even the Generation-2 Celestial like Pei Qingshuang needs to wait sixty years to be eligible to exchange for the Gold Core Spiritual Material.
“I want to try to reach Core Formation without the Gold Core Spiritual Material.”
Chen Mobai’s calm statement sparked a glimmer in Wen Renxuewei’s eyes.
She looked at the handsome and confident young man in front of her, a different spark appearing in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 741: 436 War Begins
paragraphs: Chapter 741: Chapter 436 War Begins_2

“What you’re saying isn’t necessarily impossible. But failing at Core Formation isn’t the same as failing at Foundation Establishment. Many people might only get one shot in their lifetime. You’re highly talented. If you get held up at this step and don’t fully realize your potential, it’d be a great loss for the Immortal Sect and the Daoist Academy. So think it over carefully.”

Chai Lun was mature and prudent. He cared a lot about his junior Chen Mobai and was afraid that Chen’s qualifications for Deification would meet an untimely end. Hence, he felt compelled to offer a word of advice.
“The one chance you’re talking about is because, in the Immortal Sect system, most people can only trade for one Gold Core Spiritual Material.”

“If I try to form my core without using the Gold Core Spiritual Material first, even if I fail, not only would I have gained experience, it wouldn’t affect my exchange for the Gold Core Spiritual Material.”
“Thus, during my second attempt at Core Formation, with the help of the pill, my chances of success will actually increase.”
Chen Mobai offered a seemingly plausible explanation. However, after hearing it, Chai Lun realized that it indeed made sense and started to contemplate whether he could do the same.

“Without a Gold Core Spiritual Material to protect your Dantian and Purple Palace, the backlash of failing at Core Formation could cripple the Taoist Body of most cultivators. Junior Brother Chen, it’s better if you’re more cautious.”

Wenren Xuewei, who relied on her exquisite Lasting Spring Cultivation, had attempted Core Formation several times and possessed the most extensive experience in this regard within the Immortal Sect. Her words broke Chai Lun’s reverie.

“Don’t worry. I won’t rush during my first attempt at Core Formation. If I sense any signs of failure, I’ll disperse my spiritual power. Worst case scenario, I’ll just start over. It won’t take more than a few decades.”
Having heard Chen Mobai speak with such certainty, Wenren Xuewei and Chai Lun didn’t press further.
After seeing them off, Chen Mobai returned to Crimson Mountain.
“So, what’s your next plan?”
In the office of Building One, the master and disciple were chatting over tea with satisfaction.
“I kind of want to go to the Repairing Heaven Institute.”
Facing Che Yucheng, Chen Mobai saw no need to hide anything, so he gave an honest answer.

“I approve of this. Though I hate to admit it, the fact is that Repairing Heaven does indeed possess the most substantial influence among all Immortal Sects. If you went there to pack some gold, it would make your future endeavors within the system much easier.”
Among the high-ranking cultivators of the Immortal Sect, nearly half have backgrounds related to the Repairing Heaven Institute.
Their Divinity Transformation Qian Xing...
The Xianwu Hall Master and Zhengfa Hall Master...

Moreover, the current principals of Taiyuan Academy, Primordial Elemental Academy, and the Astral Observation Academy, Yuan Xu, Qing Ping, and Mei Hua respectively, have all studied at the Repairing Heaven Institute.

If Chen Mobai had a background in the Repairing Heaven Institute, the starting point of his future career could be very high, and he might even have a real chance of becoming one of the three grand Hall Masters.
“Besides, if you can learn from the Guidance Book, it would be very helpful for your future breakthroughs and cultivation.”

Che Yucheng added another point. Among the seven Divine Transformation Cultivation Techniques of the Immortal Sect, the Guidance Book, although a Cultivation Technique, was more of a cultivation practice for divine consciousness and mentality. It was compatible with any other Cultivation Technique, and acclaimed as the number one auxiliary divine technique of the Immortal Sect.

After listening, Chen Mobai recalled the scene of his battle with Daoist Master Lou Fengcheng at the Jumang Daoist Academy. Although both of them were no match for him, under a situation of inevitable defeat, they almost probed all his cards.
That mode of fighting with the purest rationality, having entirely forgotten himself, had left a deep impression on Chen Mobai.
“Then I’m going to apply to Principal Fu Borong.”
After discussing with Che Yucheng, Chen Mobai decided where to go after graduation.
Since he had completed the No-Phase Puppet and secured the first place in the graduation project, he didn’t need to stay at the Daoist Academy for the next six months.
After leaving Building One, Chen Mobai hesitated for a moment, then gave Yan Bingxuan a call.
[After graduating, I plan on studying at the Repairing Heaven Institute for five years.]
[Okay, let me apply right away.]
After saying these words, the two fell silent.
Yan Bingxuan was a person of few words in the first place, and Chen Mobai didn’t know how to handle his feelings for her. A few more words of small talk later, they hung up.
Would she succeed in getting into Repairing Heaven?
Chen Mobai thought it over and found that he kind of hoped she would fail, just so he wouldn’t have to face her.
Yet on scrutinizing his feelings, he found that he wanted her to succeed.
He wanted to recreate their school memories.

During high school, the two of them only really came into contact with each other during the last month before the National College Entrance Examination. Yet, even those few interactions were rare and beautiful memories for Chen Mobai.
If they spent five years at the Repairing Heaven Institute, would these memories become even more beautiful?
Thinking like this, a smile appeared on Chen Mobai’s lips.
Right then, he suddenly sensed his Pure Yang Spiritual Power inside his Dantian Qi Sea, influenced by his emotions, beginning to condense and elevate rapidly.
It was time to break through!
Chen Mobai realized this and smiled slightly.
He teleported from his wooden house to Xiao Nanshan and took out an intermediate-grade Spirit Stone to start absorbing and refining spiritual energy.
At the same time, the nature’s spiritual energy on the mountain top began to converge towards the wooden house, forming a spectacular and radiant cloud of light.
“What’s this...?”
Seeing this spectacle, Xue Ting, who had been harvesting Spirit Rice with Zhuo Ming at the foot of the mountain, was stunned.
“I think our teacher’s cultivation must have made a breakthrough.”
Zhuo Ming was relatively nonchalant about it. He had already witnessed a more extravagant scene when Chen Mobai had consumed a set of tree fruits of longevity.
